plugins.description: Twelve Claude skills for day trading on the Egyptian Exchange: EGX data, a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer with a 5-minute warning, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, order tickets you enter by hand (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and an insider tracker.
